name: @papercusp/failure-detector
description: A generic, pure failure detector: φ-accrual (Hayashibara 2004 — a continuous suspicion level from observed heartbeat inter-arrivals, instead of a binary timeout) + SWIM-style indirect probing (Das 2002 — ask k relays before declaring a peer dead) + a combined eviction policy. Zero I/O, zero timers, zero domain coupling — the caller feeds heartbeats and injects the relay-probe transport; the lib decides suspicion + whether to evict.
